dust.evaporation.no_solids: Nothing would be left: it needs a solid element too
dust.research_input.block: Blocks have to be crushed to pebbles first
dust.distillation.empty: Put something in the flask first
dust.distillation.nothing: Nothing in this can be distilled: it needs at least two elements, one gaseous or aqueous

dust.transformation.nothing: Only alchemical compounds and Alchemical Dust can be transformed
dust.transformation.single: It has to be a compound of a single element
dust.transformation.unknown: You haven't discovered the element in this compound yet
dust.transformation.no_crystal: It's already dust: put an inert crystal or nether quartz on the pad to make a crystal of it
dust.combination.empty: Put Alchemical Dust on both pads first
dust.combination.not_solid: Only solid (crystalline or amorphous) dusts combine here: gaseous or aqueous ones go to the Mixing Table
dust.combination.no_element: These two don't make an element together
dust.mixing.running: It's already going: stir the pot
dust.mixing.empty: Put Alchemical Dust on both pads first

dust.mixing.no_element: These two don't make an element together
spell.dust.effect.fire.block: Lights the block: a campfire or candle, or fire against it. An item with dust in it there burns in its colour.
spell.dust.effect.water.block: Waterlogs the block, or places a water source against it.
spell.dust.effect.earth.block: Raises a dirt block in the nearest open space.
spell.dust.effect.earth.entity: Drops a pointed dripstone on it from above.
spell.dust.effect.order.self: Dispels harmful effects and lifts curses from held items.
spell.dust.effect.order.block: Sorts a container's items by name.
spell.dust.effect.order.entity: Calms it: it forgets its anger and won't pick a target for a while.
spell.dust.effect.chaos.self: Rage: strength, speed and stepping up blocks, with hunger, mining fatigue and nausea.
spell.dust.effect.chaos.entity: Turns it against the caster as if attacked; shuffles a player's inventory.
spell.dust.effect.energy.self: Your next hit drains a chunk of mana back from what you strike.
spell.dust.effect.energy.entity: Builds charge; at 100 stacks it bursts in a damaging shockwave.
spell.dust.effect.explosion.self: A flare: a firework boost while gliding, otherwise a burst high in the sky.
spell.dust.effect.explosion.block: Blows the block apart, dropping it as if mined.
spell.dust.effect.ice.self: Cooling: puts out fire and scorch.
spell.dust.effect.ice.block: Freezes water; turns lava to obsidian.
spell.dust.effect.abyss.self: Life leech on what you damage.
spell.dust.effect.abyss.block: Corrupts the block; corruption spreads until purified.
spell.dust.effect.abyss.entity: Silences it: no spells, shields, potions or teleporting.
spell.dust.effect.stone.block: Hardens loose blocks: gravel to stone, sand to sandstone, concrete powder to concrete.
spell.dust.effect.mud.self: Sure footing: the ground and water don't slow you.
spell.dust.effect.air.block: Makes the block fall if there's air beneath it.
spell.dust.effect.vacuum.self: Pulls nearby creatures and items towards you.
spell.dust.effect.vacuum.block: Keeps pulling things towards the block for a while. From a Spell Caster, what it pulls in goes into the containers around the caster: items, experience, and element orbs into Dust Jars.
spell.dust.effect.vacuum.entity: Pulls nearby mobs together around it.
spell.dust.effect.motion.block: A machine there works faster for a while.
spell.dust.effect.motion.entity: Speed, even on mounts, minecarts and elytra.
spell.dust.effect.life.block: Revives dead blocks: dead coral, dead bushes into saplings.
spell.dust.effect.life.entity: Revives fallen pets' ghosts; cures undead creatures.
spell.dust.effect.death.self: Immune to withering, drowning and hunger.
spell.dust.effect.death.block: Kills living blocks: saplings to dead bushes, coral to dead coral.
spell.dust.effect.death.entity: Kills anything under 10% health, bosses too; heals the undead instead.
spell.dust.effect.metal.block: Marks the block for good: broken, an ore drops extra; other blocks may drop a metal nugget.
spell.dust.effect.metal.entity: Bleeding, which won't stop on its own.
spell.dust.effect.tool.self: Equips the right tool for what you're breaking.
spell.dust.effect.tool.block: The block can be broken with a tool one tier lower.
spell.dust.effect.tool.entity: Lets it pick up items, armour and weapons.
spell.dust.effect.light.block: Places a coloured light you can walk through.
spell.dust.effect.darkness.block: Makes the block see-through for a while.
spell.dust.effect.radiance.self: Shares your effects with friends around you.
spell.dust.effect.radiance.block: Spreads the block's growth (grass, mycelium, nylium) around it.
spell.dust.effect.radiance.entity: Spreads its effects to the mobs around it.
spell.dust.effect.lightning.block: Draws lightning: lightning spells home in on it.
spell.dust.effect.lightning.entity: Lightning rod: more lightning damage, and lightning spells home in on it.
spell.dust.effect.flight.self: Slow falling; at its strongest, free flight. Fused with Motion, you glide.
spell.dust.effect.flight.block: The block floats, and can be punched along.
spell.dust.effect.change.self: Harmful effects are half as strong.
spell.dust.effect.change.block: Transmutes the block within its family: stairs, slab, wall, plate, button.
spell.dust.effect.change.entity: Turns it into a baby, or a baby into an adult.
spell.dust.effect.slime.self: Slippery footing, as if on ice.
spell.dust.effect.spirit.entity: Ghost form: it can't act or be hurt.
spell.dust.effect.seeds.self: Stores mana that bursts into healing when you're hurt badly.
spell.dust.effect.seeds.block: Plants the seed in your hand there. From a Spell Caster, it plants from the containers around it.
spell.dust.effect.seeds.entity: Turns it into its breeding item.
spell.dust.effect.fungus.self: Immune to poison, mining fatigue and slowness.
spell.dust.effect.fungus.entity: Turns it into a companion that attacks nearby enemies.
spell.dust.effect.armor.block: Wards the block: as tough as obsidian, safe from withers and dragons.
spell.dust.effect.protection.block: Places warded glass that stops mobs but lets players through. Explosions can't break it.
spell.dust.effect.rust.self: Corrosive aura: attacks on you are weakened.
spell.dust.effect.rust.entity: Its armour and tools wear out faster.
spell.dust.effect.crystal.self: Holds more mana and dust for a while.
spell.dust.effect.crystal.block: Crystallises sand into glass, amethyst into tinted glass.
spell.dust.effect.crystal.entity: Kinetic damage that splinters into the mobs around it.
spell.dust.effect.gem.self: Reflects arrows back at the archer.
spell.dust.effect.gem.block: Compresses the block: coal into diamond, raw ore into ore. It may crumble.
spell.dust.effect.gem.entity: Encases it in crystal; breaking out leaves it vulnerable.
spell.dust.effect.fracture.self: Crushes the items in hand: ore to raw ore, ingots to nuggets.
spell.dust.effect.fracture.block: Crumbles the block: stone to gravel, gravel to flint.
spell.dust.effect.creature.self: Pack tactics: double damage against what your allies fight.
spell.dust.effect.creature.block: Animates the block to scurry around.
spell.dust.effect.creature.entity: Marked: it takes double damage, and glows.
spell.dust.effect.flesh.block: Leaves a pool of blight that sickens whoever walks on it.
spell.dust.effect.flesh.entity: It drops extra leather, meat and flesh.
spell.dust.effect.plants.self: Photosynthesis: heals you in sunlight, and feeds you while you're under cover.
spell.dust.effect.plants.block: Grows a flower or plant there. From a Spell Caster with containers around it, it plants what's in them instead (seeds, saplings, flowers).
spell.dust.effect.plants.entity: Tangled: slowed, and thorns hurt it as it moves.
spell.dust.effect.trees.entity: Builds roots; at 100 stacks a tree grows where it stands.
spell.dust.effect.void.self: A winged ender chest appears beside you.
spell.dust.effect.void.block: Opens a rift that swallows what touches it.
spell.dust.effect.soul.self: Leaves a ghost of you as a temporary respawn that keeps your inventory.
spell.dust.effect.soul.block: The block won't drop when broken, and returns later.
spell.dust.effect.soul.entity: Pulls its soul out: it must find its body before the effect ends.
spell.dust.effect.magic.block: Amplifies the chunk's aura at the block.
spell.dust.effect.warp.self: Warps you to a marked place, or your respawn point.
spell.dust.effect.warp.block: Warps the block or items to a marked place.
spell.dust.effect.warp.entity: Warps it to a marked place, or your respawn point.
spell.dust.effect.sound.block: Plays a note block's sound for the block.
dust.spell.unknown_plants: If you wish to make anything grow, you must understand it...
dust.spell.no_target: There's nothing there for the spell
dust.magic.exhausted: A heavy weariness settles over you. Whatever that dust drew from you, you need to sleep it off.
dust.magic.dream: You dreamed of motes of colour drifting through the dark... and wake with a strange new power stirring within you.

spell_modifier.dust.category_weight.per_: +%s draw weight for the pylon's category
spell_modifier.dust.double_draw.per_leve: +%s%% chance a drawn modifier comes twice
spell_modifier.dust.transmutation.desc: Short of the element's dust, one of each of its parent elements pays for each missing dust
spell_modifier.dust.hitscan.desc: No bolt: a ray reaches the target at once
spell_modifier.dust.overshield.desc: Resistance for 2 seconds as you cast
spell_modifier.dust.aoe.desc: The effect reaches everything within its radius where it lands
spell_modifier.dust.lingering.desc: Leaves a pool that keeps putting the effect on creatures in it
spell_modifier.dust.piercing.desc: The bolt goes through creatures and blocks, affecting each
spell_modifier.dust.chaining.desc: The effect jumps to the next nearest creature
spell_modifier.dust.rune.desc: Leaves a glyph that puts the effect on whatever steps on it
spell_modifier.dust.permanent.desc: The rune stays until it's broken
spell_modifier.dust.wall.desc: The effect spreads in a line across the spell's path
spell_modifier.dust.beam.desc: Hold to channel a piercing ray
spell_modifier.dust.double_blessed.desc: Each locked pylon counts twice towards a blessing
spell_modifier.dust.fragment.desc: Becomes a random fragment for the element
spell_modifier.dust.echo.desc: The spell casts again by itself
spell_modifier.dust.aries.desc: Fire and Energy spells: double potency. Others: projectiles fly twice as fast
spell_modifier.dust.taurus.desc: Protection and Armor spells: double potency. Others: items where it lands come to you
spell_modifier.dust.gemini.desc: Air, Motion and Flight spells: double potency. Others: Speed II
spell_modifier.dust.cancer.desc: Water, Life and Healing spells: double potency. Others: Regeneration for 5 seconds
spell_modifier.dust.leo.desc: Stone, Gem and Crystal spells: double potency. Others: your pets attack what it hits
spell_modifier.dust.virgo.desc: Mud spells: double potency. Others: projectiles home in
spell_modifier.dust.libra.desc: Warp and Sound spells: double potency. Others: +10% luck
spell_modifier.dust.scorpio.desc: Magic and Knowledge spells: double potency. Others: Strength II
spell_modifier.dust.sagittarius.desc: Earth, Seeds, Plants and Trees spells: double potency. Others: step up full blocks
spell_modifier.dust.capricorn.desc: Light, Darkness and Radiance spells: double potency. Others: the next attack on you is turned back
spell_modifier.dust.aquarius.desc: Lightning and Slime spells: double potency. Others: swim fast and breathe underwater
spell_modifier.dust.pisces.desc: Vacuum and Void spells: double potency. Others: what it hits is confused
spell_modifier.dust.pride.desc: Double damage on your marked target, a quarter on anything else
spell_modifier.dust.greed.desc: Four times the damage, but it no longer spares you or your allies
spell_modifier.dust.wrath.desc: Double damage, triple the dust and mana
spell_modifier.dust.lust.desc: What it hits gets Speed V, and the mobs around turn on it
spell_modifier.dust.envy.desc: A player hit loses twice the spell's mana and you gain it, for half a heart
spell_modifier.dust.gluttony.desc: Double size, range, beam distance and depth, but four times the dust and mana
spell_modifier.dust.sloth.desc: The bolt flies half as fast, but you cast again twice as soon
hud.dust.pylon.spell_break_unpowered: Needs redstone power to carry on
hud.dust.pylon.null_corruption: Nothing more can follow it in this branch
spell_modifier.dust.fusion.desc: Links this spell to another: the next pylon beside it must belong to another spell, or be a new Spell Pylon given its crystal there. If the two elements fuse, both spells become the fusion; otherwise they stack
spell_modifier.dust.spell_stack.desc: Links this spell to another: casting either casts both, this one first
spell_modifier.dust.silky.desc: What it breaks drops as itself, explosions break no blocks, and blocks it makes don't fade. A Harvest spell plants the crops it harvests again
spell_modifier.dust.fusion_fracture_eart: Fracture and Earth fused: breaks blocks like a pickaxe (potency is its tier, luck its Fortune, Silky its Silk Touch)
spell_modifier.dust.fusion_flight_motion: Flight and Motion fused: a glide
spell_modifier.dust.prevent_block.desc: The spell does nothing to blocks. Only one of the two Prevent cards per spell
spell_modifier.dust.prevent_attack.desc: The spell does nothing to creatures. Only one of the two Prevent cards per spell
spell_modifier.dust.spell_branch.desc: Lets the spell have one more branch off its main line. One comes into the deck every 10 levels
spell_modifier.dust.fusion_warp_vacuum.d: Warp and Vacuum fused: tap to push what you look at away, hold to pull it to you, swipe and let go to throw it. Blocks are lifted out to be moved the same way
spell_modifier.dust.fusion_plants_tool.d: Plants and Tool fused: harvests grown crops (with Silky it plants them again, each Potency pylon starting them a growth stage further on), picks berries, cuts sugar cane, cactus, bamboo and kelp down to their base (luck is its Fortune). On a block with nothing to harvest it shears instead (leaves, grass, vines, cobwebs, a full beehive's honeycomb); on a creature it shears it. Self: harvests where you stand
Growth and Chaos fused: shrinks you or a creature, a quarter smaller a level. On a block it turns a plant back into its seeds
Flight and Chaos fused: turns gravity upside down. On you or a creature it falls up and walks on ceilings, drawn upside down, until it wears off (potency: a stronger pull, duration: longer). On a block it lifts the block, which rises until it meets a ceiling or the top of the world and is placed there, contents and all (potency: it rises faster)
spell_modifier.dust.fusion_change_creatu: Change and Creature fused: crouch and right-click a creature with the spell to choose it. On you or another player: you become that creature for the duration, its size, and casting or striking with a weapon does its attack (or makes its sound). Any other creature hit is turned into it for the duration, then turns back. Blocks: nothing
dust.beast.no_form: Crouch and right-click a creature with this spell to choose a form first

dust.still.upper_pot: holding dust for the pot below

dust.separator.end_blocked: the drum's open end is blocked

dust.centrifuge.needs_chute: needs a Dust Chute for it
dust.still.no_top: needs a Still Top on top of its towers
dust.still.no_fuel_below: the firebox underneath has no fuel
dust.apparatus.no_owner: no owner (right-click it with an empty hand to claim it)
dust.apparatus.dust_full: %s dust waiting: no jar on its tubes will take it
dust.caster.no_self: A Spell Caster can't cast Self spells
research.dust.note.default.blocks: %s. Its nature may be revealed by further study.
research.dust.note.default.creatures: %s. A living creature, shaped by the aura it lives in.
research.dust.note.default.bosses: %s. A being of immense power, steeped in dust.
research.dust.note.default.effects: %s. A change worked on a living body by the flow of dust.
research.dust.note.unlock_research_crush: You built a Research Crusher. Drop a block in its funnel to crush it into pebbles the other research tables can work with.
research.dust.note.unlock_research_separ: You built an Alchemical Separation Table. It splits all of one solid element out of an item; paper on its pad catches each side as a compound.
research.dust.note.unlock_research_evapo: You built an Evaporation Table. Stirring boils off the gaseous and aqueous elements and leaves the solids behind.
research.dust.note.unlock_research_disti: You built a Distillation Table. All of one gaseous or aqueous element boils over into the jar; bottles, bowls and paper catch what comes out.
research.dust.note.unlock_element_crafte: You built an Element Crafter. It crafts with dust from its jars, and building it showed you how to make the Transformation, Combination and Mixing Tables.
research.dust.note.unlock_research_trans: Building an Element Crafter showed you how to make a Transformation Table: it turns a compound of one element into Alchemical Dust, and Alchemical Dust into a crystal.
research.dust.note.unlock_research_combi: Building an Element Crafter showed you how to make a Combination Table: it puts two solid Alchemical Dusts together into a new element.
research.dust.note.unlock_research_mixin: Building an Element Crafter showed you how to make a Mixing Table: it mixes Alchemical Dusts with a gaseous or aqueous one into a new element.
research.dust.note.unlock_spell_pylon: Making your first crystal showed you how to build a Spell Pylon, at the Element Crafter.
research.dust.note.unlock_shape_pylon: Making your first crystal showed you how to build a Shape Pylon, at the Element Crafter.
research.dust.note.unlock_dust_grinder: Recording a Spell Scroll on a Spell Pylon showed you how to build a Dust Grinder, at the Element Crafter: it grinds compounds, Alchemical Dust and crystals into dust for your jars.
research.dust.note.unlock_damage_pylon: Building a Neutral Pylon showed you how to build a Damage Pylon.
research.dust.note.unlock_experienced_py: Building a Neutral Pylon showed you how to build an Experienced Pylon.
research.dust.note.unlock_thrifty_pylon: Building a Neutral Pylon showed you how to build a Thrifty Pylon.
research.dust.note.unlock_giant_pylon: Building a Neutral Pylon showed you how to build a Giant Pylon.
research.dust.note.element_tester: The first dust recipe: one item each of pure red, green, blue, white and black dust, with a crafting table, in any arrangement (a Magical Flint and Steel's flame shows which items are pure). Set crystals on it to make it an Elemental Examiner: an item on its plate lights a gauge to each crystal, one line per 10% of that crystal's element in it. The crystal sparkles when the item is all its element.
research.dust.note.default.elements.prim: %s: one of the five primal dusts everything is made of.
research.dust.note.default.enchantments: %s. Dust bound into an object, lending it a lasting power.
research.minecraft.note.stone: The bones of the world. Dust settles deep within it over countless ages.
research.minecraft.note.zombie: A body without a spirit, kept moving by stale aura. Sunlight burns it away.
research.minecraft.note.cow: A gentle grazer. Its milk soothes lingering effects.
research.dust.note.flower_windwheel: Its petals turn even in still air, as if pushed by the aura itself.
effect.dust.effect_scorch.description: Burns entity until it reaches 100, at which point it explodes.
death.attack.kinetic: %s was struck down by a magical blow
death.attack.scorch.player: %s was scorched to death trying to out run %s
effect.dust.effect_magnet.description: Magnetizes items, xp, and dust to the player.
guide.dust.hint: Drag to turn, scroll to zoom
guide.dust.research_crusher.title: The Research Crusher
guide.dust.research_crusher.1: The Research Crusher breaks any block down into pebbles, one block at a time.
guide.dust.research_crusher.2: Right-click the funnel with a block to drop it in.
guide.dust.research_crusher.3: It sinks down into the turning wheels, throwing off bits of itself...
guide.dust.research_crusher.4: ...and comes out as pebbles of it in the tray below.
guide.dust.research_crusher.5: Left-click the tray to take the pebbles (sneak to take the whole stack). Left-clicking the funnel gives back a block that's still in it.
guide.dust.research_crusher.6: Whoever put the block in gets the step in their Research Notes.
guide.dust.research_separation.title: The Alchemical Separation Table
guide.dust.research_separation.1: The Alchemical Separation Table splits one solid element out of something.
guide.dust.research_separation.2: Put paper on the pad behind the scroll: each part that comes out is caught on a sheet as an alchemical compound.
guide.dust.research_separation.3: Right-click the scroll with what you want to split, such as pebbles from the Research Crusher.
guide.dust.research_separation.4: Start it with a Magical Flint and Steel.
guide.dust.research_separation.5: One solid element, picked at random, all of it, comes out on the left...
guide.dust.research_separation.6: ...and the rest of the solids, together, on the right.
guide.dust.research_separation.7: Something needs at least two different solid elements to split. Gases and liquids in it hiss and bubble away.
guide.dust.research_separation.8: Without paper, crystalline parts still come out as compounds, but anything amorphous burns away to alchemical soot.
guide.dust.research_separation.9: Left-click an output to take it (sneak for the stack). Whoever started it gets the step in their research.
guide.dust.research_evaporation.title: The Evaporation Table
guide.dust.research_evaporation.1: The Evaporation Table boils the gaseous and aqueous elements out of something, leaving only its solids.
guide.dust.research_evaporation.2: Put something in the pot. It shows as a liquid, coloured by what will boil off.
guide.dust.research_evaporation.3: Paper on the pad behind it catches the solids that are left.
guide.dust.research_evaporation.4: Light it with a Magical Flint and Steel...
guide.dust.research_evaporation.5: ...then stir: right-click the pot once for each element in the item. The liquid bubbles and goes down with each turn.
guide.dust.research_evaporation.6: The glyph sinks into the pot and the solids stream across to the output pad.
guide.dust.research_evaporation.7: What boils off goes into the air around you.
guide.dust.research_evaporation.8: A redstone pulse can stir it as well, so it can be run without anyone standing at it.
guide.dust.research_distalation.title: The Distillation Table
guide.dust.research_distalation.1: The Distillation Table boils one gaseous or aqueous element over into the jar, and keeps the rest in the flask.
guide.dust.research_distalation.2: Put something in the flask. It needs at least two elements, one of them gaseous or aqueous.
guide.dust.research_distalation.3: Containers go on the back pads: glass bottles for gases, bowls for liquids, and paper for soot.
guide.dust.research_distalation.4: Start it with a Magical Flint and Steel.
guide.dust.research_distalation.5: Any solids left in the flask always burn to soot, caught on the paper.
guide.dust.research_distalation.7: ...and what boiled over into the jar, each caught in its container.
guide.dust.research_distalation.8: A gas or liquid without its container on the table escapes, and soot without paper blows away.
guide.dust.research_transformational.1: The Transformation Table turns your alchemical finds into their pure forms.
guide.dust.research_transformational.2: An alchemical compound of a single element you've discovered...
guide.dust.research_transformational.4: Alchemical Dust, with an inert crystal or nether quartz on the back pad...
guide.dust.research_transformational.5: ...becomes a crystal of its element. One crystal is used each time.
guide.dust.research_combination.title: The Combination Table
guide.dust.research_combination.1: The Combination Table combines two solid Alchemical Dusts into the element they make together.
guide.dust.research_combination.2: Put a solid (crystalline or amorphous) Alchemical Dust on each side pad.
guide.dust.research_combination.3: Start it with a Magical Flint and Steel.
guide.dust.research_combination.4: The glyph pulls both in, and the element they make streams down to the output: Fire and Earth make Metal.
guide.dust.research_combination.5: Two dusts that don't make an element won't start. Each element's Elements entry shows what it's made from, once you've discovered it.
guide.dust.research_mixing.title: The Mixing Table
guide.dust.research_mixing.1: The Mixing Table mixes two Alchemical Dusts, at least one of them gaseous or aqueous, into the element they make.
guide.dust.research_mixing.2: Put an Alchemical Dust on each side pad.
guide.dust.research_mixing.3: Start it with a Magical Flint and Steel: both dusts pour into the pot.
guide.dust.research_mixing.4: Stir it: right-click the pot twice. The liquid turns the colour of the new element.
guide.dust.research_mixing.5: It settles, and the new dust streams to the output: Water and Fire make Air.
guide.dust.station_automation.title: Running a station with machines
guide.dust.station_automation.1: Every research station can be run by machines.
guide.dust.station_automation.2: A hopper above fills its input: the scroll, the pot or the flask.
guide.dust.station_automation.3: Hoppers at the sides stock its supplies: paper, containers and crystals.
guide.dust.station_automation.4: A hopper below takes the outputs out.
guide.dust.station_automation.5: A redstone pulse stirs/spins Workstations that need it, a button on a block beside it or a repeater clock.
guide.dust.station_automation.6: A dispenser holding a Magical Flint and Steel, facing the station, starts the process (one durability each time), and so does a fire spell landing on it.
guide.dust.dust_tube_shears.1: Shears on a tube's side cut it from what's beside it: aim at the arm, or the face of the middle.
guide.dust.dust_tube_shears.2: Shears on a cut side join it again (unless it's set to another element).
guide.dust.dust_tube_shears.3: Honeycomb waxes a tube: it keeps how it's joined and joins nothing new, not even tubes placed beside it. Handy for jars side by side.
guide.dust.dust_tube_shears.4: An axe scrapes the wax off.
guide.dust.dust_tube_shears.title: Cutting and waxing tubes
guide.dust.dust_mixer_wet.1: The Wet Dust Mixer mixes two elements into the one made of them when at least one is gaseous or aqueous: Fire and Water make Air. Two solids go to the Dust Mixer instead.
guide.dust.dust_mixer_wet.2: Pipe them in at its back or from underneath: no other side takes tubes. Here redstone on the tubes' ends pulls them out of the jars.
guide.dust.dust_mixer_wet.3: Its head stays tilted back while it fills, up to 100 of each. Once both are full, or nothing more has come for a moment, the head comes down into the pot.
guide.dust.dust_mixer_wet.4: Its beater mixes an even amount of each, 2 ticks for each dust it makes, and the dust turns from their colours to the colour of what they make.
guide.dust.dust_mixer_wet.5: Then the pot tips forward on its arms and pours what it made out in front as a Dust Pile, and comes back for the next load.
guide.dust.dust_mixer_wet.6: A redstone signal stops it, as it does the Dust Mixer: it tips out what it has and stays tipped until the signal goes.
guide.dust.dust_mixer_wet.title: Wet Dust Mixer
guide.dust.dust_mixer.1: The Dust Mixer mixes two solid elements piped in from its sides into the element made of them: Fire and Earth make Metal.
guide.dust.dust_mixer.2: With its grate open it fills up to 100 of each. Once both are full, or no more has come for a moment, the grate closes and its paddles mix an even amount of each: 2 ticks for each dust it makes.
guide.dust.dust_mixer.3: While it mixes, the dust turns from the colours of the two to the colour of what they make.
guide.dust.dust_mixer.4: Then the bowl tips forward and pours what it made out in front of it as a Dust Pile, and tips back for the next load.
guide.dust.dust_mixer.5: A redstone signal stops it: it tips out what it has (what's mixed so far, and the rest as it went in) and stays tipped until the signal goes.
guide.dust.dust_mixer.title: Dust Mixer
guide.dust.dust_cyclone.1: The Dust Cyclone spins a solid element made of two others apart. It sits on a Dust Cyclone Hopper.
guide.dust.dust_cyclone.2: It takes dust in at its back only. Here redstone on the tube's end pulls Metal (Fire and Earth) out of the top of a jar: a tube can pull from any side of a jar.
guide.dust.dust_cyclone.3: The lighter of the two goes out along the tubes at its front (gaseous is lightest, then aqueous, amorphous and crystalline): here Fire.
guide.dust.dust_cyclone.4: The heavier spirals down the hopper and drops out of its spout as a Dust Pile: here Earth.
guide.dust.dust_cyclone.5: With no hopper under it, or nowhere for either part to go, it stops until there is.
guide.dust.dust_cyclone.title: Dust Cyclone
guide.dust.dust_centrifuge.1: The Dust Centrifuge spins a gaseous or aqueous element made of two others apart. Solid ones go to the Dust Cyclone.
guide.dust.dust_centrifuge.2: Pipe it in at its back: it fills its four vials, up to 100. Once they're full, or nothing more has come for a while, it spins.
guide.dust.dust_centrifuge.3: Dust Chutes on its sides let out what it makes. Filter one with your Research Notes open at an element's page (or an element's dust) to keep it to that element.
guide.dust.dust_centrifuge.4: It spins up, the vials swinging out, and as it spins the dust comes apart into the two it's made of, slowly turning their colours: two vials of each.
guide.dust.dust_centrifuge.5: Then it drains out of the chutes as Dust Piles under them: a filtered chute lets out only its element, and an element with no chute for it waits. Empty, it fills again.
guide.dust.dust_centrifuge.title: Dust Centrifuge
guide.dust.dust_seperator.1: The Dust Separator tumbles things apart. Feed it from its intake side (the blue crystal, on the right as it's placed): only things made of solid elements alone.
guide.dust.dust_seperator.2: Extensions lengthen the drum from its open end, up to 5. The whole drum turns together.
guide.dust.dust_seperator.3: Each drum section sends one solid element down the tubes under it: first one whose jars are set to it (a labelled jar filters it), then one whose jars aren't set yet.
guide.dust.dust_seperator.4: Everything else, and any element no section's tubes have room for, falls out of the open end of the drum as Dust Piles.
guide.dust.dust_seperator.title: Dust Separator
guide.dust.still.1: The Still is built bottom up. The Burnable Firebox burns furnace fuel and heats the 5 blocks above it.
guide.dust.still.2: Every piece of fuel leaves an Alchemical Soot, put into a chest beside the firebox (never a hopper). With nowhere for it, it keeps a stack, and a full stack goes into the void.
guide.dust.still.3: The Still Pot boils what's put in it, one at a time: only things with a gaseous or aqueous element in them. Things made of solids alone go to the Dust Separator.
guide.dust.still.4: Gases and liquids rise into the Still Towers above: one element to a tower, 100 dust each. Each element needs its own tower; a tower's window shows its element while the pot boils.
guide.dust.still.5: Tubes on a tower's sides carry its dust off to jars of its element (a tower won't join tubes set to another).
guide.dust.still.6: The Still Top caps it. Whatever no tower takes leaves through it into the chunk's aura, as smoke in its colour. With only a top on the pot, everything goes to the aura.
guide.dust.still.7: Solid elements stay in the pots instead (see Still Pots).
guide.dust.still.title: The Still
guide.dust.still_pots.1: Each Still Pot holds one solid element as dust, up to 100.
guide.dust.still_pots.2: Stack more pots for more solid elements; things can go into any of them. A solid no pot can take makes an extra soot, given out by the firebox.
guide.dust.still_pots.3: A Dust Chute on a pot's side lets its dust out as Dust Piles under it.
guide.dust.still_pots.4: Right-click a chute or a pot with your Research Notes open at an element's page to filter it to that element (nothing is used up). A filtered chute shows the element and keeps its pot to it; shears take a filter off.
guide.dust.still_pots.5: A Jar Label on a pot holding an element keeps it to that element too, even empty.
guide.dust.still_pots.title: Still Pots
guide.dust.dust_collector.1: The Dust Collector gathers the Dust Piles lying on the 3x3 blocks over it, up to 100 dust of any elements.
guide.dust.dust_collector.2: It sends each element out along the tubes on its sides and bottom (each tube network takes only its own element). An element it has no tubes for passes to a collector beside it that does.
guide.dust.dust_collector.3: Right-click it with a Dust Jar to fill the jar from it. Broken, its dust comes out as element orbs.
guide.dust.dust_collector.title: Dust Collector
guide.dust.dust_tube_pulling.1: Tubes only carry what machines put in. To draw dust out of a jar, put redstone on the tube's end at that jar.
guide.dust.dust_tube_pulling.2: That end pulls from that jar and sends it along the network to the other stores (never back into that jar, never spilled). It works on any side of a jar, its top and bottom too, and each end on a jar can have its own redstone.
guide.dust.dust_tube_pulling.3: Sneak and right-click the end with an empty hand to take the redstone back off.
guide.dust.dust_tube_pulling.title: Pulling from jars
guide.dust.jar_labels.1: A label only goes on a jar that has an element, and a jar takes one label.
guide.dust.jar_labels.2: Labelled, the jar is locked to its element: emptied, it keeps it and can't be cleared. Tubes treat it as set to that element.
guide.dust.jar_labels.3: Pick it up and place it again: its label turns to face you.
guide.dust.jar_labels.4: Shears scrape the label off. Then sneak and right-click the empty jar to clear its element.
guide.dust.jar_labels.title: Jar labels
guide.dust.dust_tubes.1: Glass Dust Tubes carry the dust an apparatus makes to the Dust Jars at their ends.
guide.dust.dust_tubes.2: They join each other, and the blocks that take them: jars, apparatus and Still Towers.
guide.dust.dust_tubes.3: While dust runs through, a tube fills with its colour.
guide.dust.dust_tubes.4: A jar takes the first element poured into it and keeps it.
guide.dust.dust_tubes.5: Once the dust stops, the tubes empty from the far end back.
guide.dust.dust_tubes.title: Glass Dust Tubes
guide.dust.dust_tube_elements.1: Each tube network carries one element: the element of the jars on it.
guide.dust.dust_tube_elements.2: A tube won't join a network, jar or Still Tower set to another element. It takes the element of what it was placed against, and stays cut off from the other.
guide.dust.dust_tube_elements.3: Empty jars with no element yet don't count, so tubes join them freely.
guide.dust.dust_tube_elements.title: One element to a network
guide.dust.dust_tube_machines.1: Tubes always join machines. A machine can feed several separate networks.
guide.dust.dust_tube_machines.2: Each network only takes its own element: Fire goes to the Fire jars...
guide.dust.dust_tube_machines.3: ...and Water to the Water jars. A network with no element set yet takes what the others don't.
guide.dust.dust_tube_machines.4: Dust no network will take waits in the machine, and the machine stops once it's full. Tubes with no jar at all spill it on the ground.
guide.dust.dust_tube_machines.title: Machines and several networks
guide.dust.dust_spilling.1: Tubes from a machine with no jar on them spill the dust out of their open end.
guide.dust.dust_spilling.2: It piles up in Dust Piles that slump out into a mound, any elements mixed together. A full block of pile holds 100 dust.
guide.dust.dust_spilling.3: A pile never grows higher than the tube's end: then the tube backs up and the machine stops.
guide.dust.dust_spilling.4: Break a pile with a shovel to get its dust back as element orbs. Piles fall like sand when what's under them goes.
guide.dust.dust_spilling.title: Spilled dust
guide.dust.dust_clouds.1: Dust Piles out in the open fill the air 9 blocks across round them with dust: the more dust, the harder it is to see through.
guide.dust.dust_clouds.2: Where the air holds 500 dust or more (half see-through), a spark sets it off: an open flame (fire, a lit campfire or firebox, lava), a creeper walking through, a spell, or a Magical Flint and Steel.
guide.dust.dust_clouds.3: Every pile in the cloud goes up at once, and the piles in reach of them too. The blast breaks blocks (they drop), bigger the more dust burns.
guide.dust.dust_clouds.4: Explosions, the dust they take, their power and the cloud's size can be changed in the server config.
guide.dust.dust_clouds.title: Dust clouds and explosions
